correctness.rationale: All 216 triples of row permutations yield precisely 12 Latin squares; independently the affine family ai+bj+c (a,b=1 or2) yields the same 12. Subtracting one incidence vector produces binary span D of rank8, with 12 affine quotient coordinates. Exhausting all 256 quotient characters yields signed multiplier histogram {-8:2,-4:45,0:108,4:90,8:10,12:1}; each has 2^19 ambient extensions and anchor outside D ensures symmetric signs, establishing the complete 2^27 frequency distribution. Transforming the indicator of the 148 nonzero quotient frequencies gives |H| histogram {0:12,4:81,8:108,12:54,148:1}, sum |H|=1984 and kernel L1 norm 1984/256=31/4. Translation averaging every projection onto translation-invariant range yields the unique invariant Fourier support projection, so 31/4 is the minimum even among non-invariant real/complex projections. Independent exact enumeration regenerated all counts and the two Parseval identities. This is exhaustive finite mathematics for n=3, not an extrapolation to all orders.
